title: Product Manager
description: Product Manager responsible for product strategy and execution.

questionBank.question: Tell me about a time you had to pivot a product strategy based on user feedback.
followUpQuestions: How did you validate the feedback?

questionBank.question: How do you prioritize features for a new product launch?
followUpQuestions: How do you balance tech debt vs new features?

questionBank.question: Your engineering team says a critical feature will take 3 months instead of 1. What do you do?
followUpQuestions: How do you communicate this to leadership?
